meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比本地代码与已发布版本，列出未发布的变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要知道哪些代码改动还没发布到npm
copy.tagline_en: Compare local code with published npm versions and list unpublished changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know which code changes are not yet published to npm

howto.what: 当你询问时，Claude 会比较当前代码与最新发布的 npm 包版本，按发布层列出所有未发布的变更，并描述每项变更的实际内容和重要性，还会推荐版本更新版本号。
howto.when: 当用户提到“unpublished changes”、“changelog”、“what changed”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 列出我们仓库中所有未发布的变更。
say.note: Claude 会分析最新版本与 HEAD 的差异。

say.text: 从最新的 npm 版本到当前代码有哪些变化？
say.note: Claude 会按发布层分类列出变更。

howto.what_en: When you ask, Claude compares the current code with the latest published npm versions, lists all unpublished changes by release layer, describes the actual changes and their significance, and recommends version bumps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention keywords like 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', etc.

say_en.text: List all unpublished changes in our repository.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the diff between latest version and HEAD.

say_en.text: What changed from the latest npm version to the current code?
say_en.note: Claude categorizes changes by release layer.
